{{Quote|The ''Devastator'' is mine, and those who oppose me will meet a swift end.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="TAODV">{{StoryCite|story=The Assassination of Darth Vader|book=Free Comic Book Day 2013 Special}}</ref>}}
The '''''Devastator''''' was an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] famous for its participation in the capture of the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] and as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] for a time.

==Characteristics==
[[File:DevastatorTantiveIV.png|thumb|left|170px|Aft view of the ''Devastator''{{'s}} engines]]
At some point in its service life, the ''Devastator'' was structurally altered from its original design to hold an increased amount of armament and munitions.<ref name="MOTF" />

==History==
{{Quote|I.S.D. Mark One, flagship of late Lord Tion. Saw extensive action in Subjugation of Ralltiir. Post-Yavin, Lord Vader assumed control.|[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Kell Bircher]]|<ref name="SW2:ItSoY2" />}}
In [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]], the ''Devastator'' was serving with Darth Vader's personal fleet. When a secret biological weapons research laboratory on [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]] required containment, Vader ordered the ''Devastator'' to [[Bombardment of Falleen|bombard]] the surface with [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire, despite [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bolvan/Legends|Bolvan's]] preference for a ground assault.

By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the ''Devastator'' was acting as [[Tion (Lord)/Legends|Lord Tion's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] in his campaign against [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] outposts. Under Tion, the ''Devastator'' also participated in the [[Subjugation of Ralltiir|Subjugation of]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]].

{{IBI|File:Devastator-TCG Core Set.jpg|The ''Devastator'' chases the ''Tantive IV''.}}
Following Tion's death, Vader raised his flag on the ''Devastator'' and began his pursuit of the Rebel who had [[Operation Skyhook|stolen the plans]] to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. Vader caught the ''Tantive IV'' at [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]] and chased it to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where it was successfully [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|captured]] by the ''Devastator''. Vader quickly dispatched a [[TIE/br boarding shuttle]] filled with the troops of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], and boarded the ''Tantive IV''. Later the crew of the ''Devastator'' attached a portable accessway to the corvette. The ''Devastator'' also targeted and destroyed any escape pods that were launched in order to ensure none of the Rebels escaped. The sole exception was R2-D2 and C-3PO's escape pod&mdash;which even then was only because they didn't detect any life signs in the pod, and dismissed it as a malfunction.<ref name="EP4NOVEL">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]</ref><ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

During those events, [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] of the [[Anchorhead Base]] moved to intercept it. [[Rookie One]] and [[Ru Murleen]] were called from [[Kolaador]] and joined with [[Thurlow Harris]] against the Devastator. They intercepted the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] moving against them while Rookie One destroyed the Star Destroyer's emplacement cannons, destroyed its [[ISD-72x deflector shield generator dome|shield generators]] and managed to damage its bridge.<ref name="Star Wars: Rebel Assault">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]''</ref>

It was the ''Devastator''{{'s}} forces, including the famed [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], that defeated the Rebel forces on Tatooine and gave chase to the fleeing [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. Captain [[Mulchive Wermis]] served Vader as the vessel's captain throughout this time period and in the following months, during the blockade of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]], the [[assault on Ultaar]], and other missions.

The next year, the vessel served in the [[Blockade of Kashyyyk (1 ABY)|Blockade of Kashyyyk]].

===Later history and destruction===
{{Quote|Rest easy, gentlemen. Your fears betray you. I am not here to take command of this ship again.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to the command staff of the ''Devastator''|<ref name="Star Wars (2013) 13">[[Star Wars (2013) 13|''Star Wars'' (2013) 13]]</ref>}}
[[File:ImperialStarDestroyerPainting-SWG.png|thumb|left|180px|The ''Devastator'']]
When the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] completed construction, Vader transferred his flag, but the ''Devastator'' remained a part of his roving, Rebel-hunting [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]].

Prior to the completion of the ''Executor'', the vessel was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nevik]]. Agent [[Sollaine]], head of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] and Vader's rival, commandeered the ship to track down undercover Rebel spies. Nevik and Sollaine came to a clash of opinion, Sollaine believing the agents to be on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] while Nevik believed they were in the [[Alfestril system/Legends|Alfestril system]]. Sollaine executed Nevik to have his way, but Vader intercepted the vessel at Corulag and killed Sollaine for executing Nevik.<ref name="SF" />

Eight months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the ship [[Battle of the Poln system|fought]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s forces in the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]] as part of [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]].<ref name="CoO">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>

{{IBI|File:Death of the Devastator.jpg|Destruction of the ''Devastator''}}
Around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] an ISB captain [[Jeffren Brek]] arrived to the ''Devastator'' to present a report to his superior, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Nevar/Legends|Nevar]].<ref name="TNR">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref> The ''Devastator'' had participated at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] under command of an unnamed captain as part of the [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]].

It was finally destroyed during the events of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], under a concentrated attack of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] and [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]].<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Although the ''Devastator'' was Darth Vader's flagship prior to the [[Operation Skyhook]], the authors of ''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]'' mention that Vader was on ''[[Immortal/Legends|Immortal]]''.

A ''Devastator'' appears in the game ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'', but it is an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]]. The limited context doesn't provide enough information to determine whether this is a blooper or a different ship altogether.

In [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']], the ''Devastator'' is, at one point, erroneously identified as a [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]]. This may be a mistaken reference to Darth Vader's [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] flagship, [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], which was called a Super Star Destroyer by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]].

The ''Devastator'' was the second ship seen in the entire series, after the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']]. Although in-universe it dwarfed the ''Tantive IV'', its production model for filming was half the size of the ''Tantive IV''{{'s}} production model.<ref name="Imperial Boarding Party">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/explore/visualguides/chp03.html|text=Episode IV Visual Guide &mdash; Chapter 3: Imperial Boarding Party}}</ref>

===Non-canon stories===
In the non-canon story [[Tantive IV (comic story)|''Tantive IV'']], originally published in [[Star Wars Manga: Black]] issue of [[Tokyopop's Star Wars Manga]], the ''Devastator'' mistakenly captures [[Tantive V (CR90 corvette)|''Tantive V'']] over Tatooine, a decoy ship masquerading as ''Tantive IV'' and manned entirely by [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]]. Vader soon realizes the mistake and captures the real ''Tantive IV'' less than an hour later.<ref name="Tantive IV">{{StoryCite|story=Tantive IV (comic story)|book=Star Wars Manga: Black|stext=''Tantive IV''}}</ref>
